query.q: search term, min 2 chars after server-side handling; param name is case-insensitive (Q works); duplicate q params are comma-joined (q=watch&q=book searches 'watch,book' -> no match)
query.c: category id (int, repeatable; multiple = OR/union: c=12&c=4 gave 5 hits vs 1 for c=12); unknown id -> 0 hits; non-numeric ignored
query.p: price range 'from~to' (either side optional, '~100' = up to 100; reversed '100~10' behaves as 10~100; non-numeric ignored); value is in the current currency
query.r: minimum rating; UI offers 1..4. q=er: r=0,1,2,3 -> 37, r=4 -> 30, r=5 -> 1 (non-increasing); r=9 and r=-1 -> 502 Bad Gateway
query.d: delivery time id (UI: 1,2,3); d=1 -> 11 hits, d=2 -> 2, d=3 -> 24; unknown id (0, 99) -> 0 hits ('did not match')
query.a: availability flag a=True; a=False/1 produced the unfiltered count on this dataset
query.o: sort order: 1 Relevance, 5 Name A-Z, 6 Name Z-A, 10 Price low-high, 11 Price high-low, 15 Newest; unknown/non-numeric falls back to relevance
query.s: page size: UI offers 12,24,36,48,72,120; default 24; any positive int accepted (s=5 gives 5, s=1000 and non-numeric give all/1-38); s=0 -> 'did not match' message; s=-1 -> 502
query.i: 1-based page index; 0, negative, non-numeric -> page 1; beyond last page -> last page
query.v: view mode list|grid; v=list switches class 'artlist-lines', anything else -> grid
